messages:
maya: Heads up — thinking about how SDKs should handle pagination + streaming when retries happen. Wanted to capture tradeoffs before the RFC follow-up.

 tom: Couple scenarios: (A) idempotent cursor resume (B) stateless offset token (C) streaming resume with partial frames. Which one are we standardizing?

 lina: :100: we should prefer cursor tokens returned by server, but SDKs need a consistent backoff/retry window so we don't duplicate results.

 archie: Agree. Proposal: make cursor tokens opaque and monotonic; provide `resume_token` semantics in all SDKs. For streaming, also emit `last_confirmed_offset` events.

 samir: Question: how to reconcile with transports? HTTP/1 long-poll vs HTTP/2 stream vs WebSocket — reconnect semantics differ.

 maya: Idea: abstract transport-level reconnect in the transport layer and expose a single semantic: 'try_resume(retry_budget, idempotency_key, last_token)'. Keep retry_budget per-request.

 tom: Implementation detail: add optional `idempotency_key` header and `x-resume-token` on responses. Pseudocode: ```http
POST /v1/streams
X-Idempotency-Key: 123
```
SDK picks that up.

 lina: Edge case: if model server changes variant during retry (e.g., fallback to cheaper quantized) we might get duplicate semantics. We need guarantee: server must support `resume_token` idempotency across model variants or SDK falls back to full restart.

 archie: Operational constraint: we can't force model variant idempotency today. So SDK should expose 'best_effort_resume' flag: true => resume when possible, false => restart and surface `partial_results`.

 samir: For TS/Go/Python surface differences: TS async iterator, Go channel, Python async generator. Keep same method names: `.resume(token)` and `.reset()` so app-level code is similar.

 maya: Good point — also add `retry_window_ms` metadata on route config. Default 30s. SDKs apply exponential backoff within that window and then give up.

 tom: Concrete API sketch for Python: ```py
gen = client.stream(..., resume_token=None, idempotency_key=...)
await gen.resume(token)
```

 lina: We must document semantics: resume may duplicate last partial item. Recommend callers dedupe by item id.

 sdk-bot: note: added 'resume_token' header to API spec draft 0.2. Link: https://redwood-specs.internal/streams/resume/v0.2 :rocket:

 maya: Action items: (1) Lina draft SDK surface changes for PY/TS/Go (2) Archie add transport adapter with `try_resume` hook (3) Tom update API spec with header names and retry_window default. Ping in 48h.

 tom: :thumbsup: I'll own spec update.

 lina: :raised_hands: I'll do PY + TS sketches, will post PR.

 archie: I'll add an eng-platform ticket and prototype transport shim. Will include a small perf check for reconnections.
